answer_1.quote: We present an approach to produce fluent natural language questions targeting any predicate and semantic role in the context of a passage.

answer_4.quote: We source our data from existing SRL datasets and use human evaluation by a curated set of trusted workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: We assess grammaticality and adequacy on a 5‑point Likert scale and measure role correspondence with role accuracy and QA accuracy.
